# Sneeze Media

> Sneeze Media is a full-stack creative and digital marketing agency in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. It creates AI-generated visuals, social media content and campaigns, product and fashion photography, performance ads, UGC (user-generated content) videos, and fast, SEO-optimised websites for ambitious brands in Jaipur and across India.

- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9929103969, +91 9549791480
- Website: https://www.sneeze.media
- Start a project: https://www.sneeze.media/project

## Services

- [AI content creation agency in Jaipur](https://www.sneeze.media/ai-visuals): AI-generated product photos, posters, video synthesis and storyboards, polished by human retouchers.
- [Social media marketing agency in Jaipur](https://www.sneeze.media/social-cults): Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, trend-led content and community building.
- [Product & fashion photography in Jaipur](https://www.sneeze.media/editorial): Editorial, product and lookbook shoots with art direction and colour grading.
- [Performance marketing agency in Jaipur](https://www.sneeze.media/performance): Meta, Google, YouTube and LinkedIn ads with creative testing and ROAS-focused scaling.
- [UGC video production in Jaipur](https://www.sneeze.media/ugc): Creator matching, briefing, product seeding and editing UGC into ads.
- [Web design & development agency in Jaipur](https://www.sneeze.media/web-experience): Custom Next.js/React, Shopify, WordPress and Wix websites built for speed and SEO.

## How we work

1. Discover: research the brand, audience and competitors.
2. Strategise: channels, formats, hooks and success metrics.
3. Create: AI visuals, shoots, reels and UGC.
4. Launch: publish and run campaigns on the platforms customers use.
5. Optimise: weekly testing; scale what converts.
6. Scale: multiply winning creative across platforms and budgets.
